value parameter of Bonding.deposit, amount of ETHC staged
value parameter of Bonding.withdraw, amount of ETHC withdrawn
value parameter of Bonding.bond, staged ETHC converted to stake
value parameter of Bonding.unbond, bonded stake amount

couponAmount parameter of Market.redeemCoupons
sender parameter of Market.transferCoupons

normalization_plan.reason: The value parameter only exists to size the staged balance update inside deposit
The value parameter only exists to size the outgoing token transfer and staged debit in withdraw
The value parameter is consumed entirely by the stake scaling logic of bond
The value parameter is consumed entirely by the unbond conversion logic
ethicAmount is only used to compute premium and burn from the caller in purchaseCoupons
couponEpoch selects the coupon bucket debited inside redeemCoupons
couponAmount is the redeemed quantity consumed inside redeemCoupons
sender is the coupon source account used only by transferCoupons
recipient is the coupon destination account used only by transferCoupons
amount is the transferred quantity and allowance debit used only by transferCoupons
candidate is the vote target only meaningful inside the vote routine
newImplementation is the address installed and delegatecalled by upgradeTo
staged is an intermediate computed and immediately credited inside unbond
burnAmount is the penalty sub-result used only within redeemCoupons
redeemAmount is the payout sub-result used only within redeemCoupons
bonded is the local stake weight used only within the vote tally updates
recordedVote is the previous vote read only within the vote reconciliation logic
timeIntoEpoch is a timestamp derived intermediate used only by the penalty view
couponAge is an epoch derived intermediate used only by the penalty view
newSupply is repeatedly mutated and consumed only inside increaseSupply
